Guidance & outlook: So, the guidance for this year, as we have indicated, about 10 -12% on the top line should also apply to this business, and our profitability should improve from the last year.
Again, on the outlook, we are at about 550-600 crore budget, out of which we've done about 167 crores.
Your guidance on 12-15% puts a lot of ask on the second half.
Growth & demand: On the quarter gone by, it's a consecutive quarter, 24th consecutive quarter of growth, grew at about 9% on the top line console level.
As I said, some of it has come because of volume growth and some of it has come because of slight value growth.
Our trans system has grown at about 11.5% also on the top line, about the same kind of percentage growth.
Margins & costs: On the freight business side, the margin has been slight, there has been slight improvement, but top line has also grown by about 10-11%.
EBITDA is about 1.6% flat on the standalone as well as about 5-ish% on the console level.

But the margin profile of the business is such that you will should achieve a 25-30% kind of EBITDA, irrespective of, you know, some, you absorb some of the costs also and some revenue increases might happen also.
Capex & expansion: The investment in the first quarter was about 167 crores.
On the Cold Chain side, we've acquired some decent contracts in Q3-Q4 of last year, which has started to play out in this year.
Sir, you have outlined a capex of around 1,000 to 1,200 crores for the coming three years.
Balance sheet & cash: Our dividend that we received from the JVs also was slightly lower in the first quarter.
So, our receivable days are working capital days, rather 55 to 56 days.
So, going forward, you know, there is a Capex plan in the next 4-5 years, and based on the free cash flows is what we are looking at in terms of dividend income.
Risks & challenges: So, container repo, that is repositioning, has also been a challenge.
Of course, international container prices have also gone up substantially, as you are aware, and that is also putting pressure on exports.

The problem has always been that there used to be volume surges during the month end, as well as there used to be delays in the return management, as well as the picking system used to be quite outdated.

guidance.t: So, again, I think this business should grow in the higher teens, 12-15% for the top line.
